points.title: 童年成长
points.description: 1916年10月26日，弗朗索瓦·密特朗出生于法国夏朗德省的雅纳克一个中产阶级家庭。他的父亲是铁路站站长，母亲是虔诚的天主教徒。密特朗在雅纳克度过了童年时光，接受了传统天主教教育，这段经历塑造了他后来对社会不公的关注和对底层民众的同情。他的家庭背景和早期教育为他日后进入政坛奠定了思想基础，培养了他对法国传统价值观的认同。
points.descriptionEn: François Mitterrand was born on October 26, 1916, in Jarnac, Charente, France, into a middle-class family. His father was a railway station master, and his mother was a devout Catholic. Mitterrand spent his childhood in Jarnac, receiving traditional Catholic education that shaped his later concern for social injustice and sympathy for the underprivileged. His family background and early education laid the ideological foundation for his future political career, fostering his identification with French traditional values.

points.title: 求学与早期政治
points.description: 1934年，密特朗前往巴黎求学，在巴黎政治学院学习法律和政治学。在此期间，他积极参与右翼民族主义组织'火十字团'，表现出对民族主义的热情。1938年，他获得法学学位，并开始在巴黎法院担任律师。这一时期，密特朗的政治立场开始形成，他既受到法国传统保守思想的影响，也开始关注社会问题，为日后政治生涯积累了经验和人脉。
points.descriptionEn: In 1934, Mitterrand moved to Paris to study law and political science at the Sciences Po. During this period, he actively participated in the right-wing nationalist organization 'Croix-de-Feu', showing enthusiasm for nationalism. In 1938, he obtained his law degree and began practicing law in Paris courts. This period saw the formation of Mitterrand's political stance, influenced by both French traditional conservative thought and growing concern for social issues, accumulating experience and connections for his future political career.

points.title: 二战经历
points.description: 二战爆发后，密特朗应征入伍，1940年在吕内维尔战役中受伤被俘。在德国战俘营期间，他组织抵抗活动，并成功于1941年越狱回到法国。回国后，他加入了维希政府，担任'战俘与流亡者事务部'的负责人，这一决定成为他政治生涯中最大的争议点。1943年，他转向戴高乐领导的'自由法国'运动，参与抵抗运动。这段复杂的战时经历塑造了密特朗的政治形象，也成为了他政治对手日后攻击他的主要靶点。
points.descriptionEn: After WWII broke out, Mitterrand was drafted and wounded in the Battle of Lunéville in 1940, then taken prisoner. In a German POW camp, he organized resistance activities and successfully escaped in 1941. Returning to France, he joined the Vichy government, serving as head of the 'Prisoners and Deportees' department—a decision that became the most controversial point of his political career. In 1943, he switched to Charles de Gaulle's 'Free France' movement and participated in the resistance. This complex wartime experience shaped Mitterrand's political image and later became a primary target for his political opponents.

points.title: 政治崛起
points.description: 二战后，密特朗开始活跃于法国政坛，先后担任退伍军人部长、海外领地部长、内政部长等职。1958年，他反对戴高乐宪法，创立了'民主与社会主义共和党联盟'，逐渐成为左翼领袖。1965年，他首次竞选总统失败，但确立了作为主要反对派领袖的地位。1969年再次竞选失败后，他重组左翼力量，创立了'社会党'。1971-1981年间，他领导法国左翼力量，多次挑战执政党，最终在1981年总统选举中击败吉斯卡尔·德斯坦，成为法国第一位社会党总统。这一时期，密特朗逐步建立了自己在法国政坛的领导地位，形成了独特的政治风格。
points.descriptionEn: After WWII, Mitterrand became active in French politics, serving as Minister of Veterans Affairs, Minister of Overseas Territories, and Minister of the Interior. In 1958, he opposed de Gaulle's constitution and founded the 'Democratic and Socialist Republican Union', gradually becoming a left-wing leader. He ran for president in 1965 but lost, establishing himself as the main opposition leader. After another failed presidential bid in 1969, he reorganized left-wing forces and founded the Socialist Party. Between 1971 and 1981, he led French left-wing forces, challenging the ruling party multiple times, and finally defeated Valéry Giscard d'Estaing in the 1981 presidential election, becoming France's first socialist president. During this period, Mitterrand gradually established his leadership position in French politics and developed a unique political style.

points.title: 总统任期
points.description: 1981-1995年，密特朗担任法国总统，成为第五共和国任期最长的总统。他推行了一系列左翼改革，包括缩短工作时间、提高最低工资、扩大社会福利等。1982年，他实施国有化政策，将银行和关键工业部门收归国有。在外交政策上，他推动欧洲一体化，支持《马斯特里赫特条约》，同时保持法国的独立外交立场。1988年连任后，他调整政策，转向'务实社会主义'，减少国家干预。1991年海湾战争中，他反对美国主导的军事行动，主张和平解决。密特朗的总统任期见证了法国社会的重大变革，也面临经济衰退、高失业率等挑战。
points.descriptionEn: From 1981 to 1995, Mitterrand served as President of France, becoming the longest-serving president of the Fifth Republic. He implemented a series of left-wing reforms, including reducing working hours, increasing the minimum wage, and expanding social welfare. In 1982, he implemented nationalization policies, bringing banks and key industrial sectors under state control. In foreign policy, he promoted European integration, supported the Maastricht Treaty, while maintaining France's independent diplomatic stance. After re-election in 1988, he shifted policies toward 'practical socialism,' reducing state intervention. During the Gulf War in 1991, he opposed US-led military operations, advocating for peaceful solutions. Mitterrand's presidency witnessed significant social changes in France but also faced challenges such as economic recession and high unemployment.

points.title: 晚年与遗产
points.description: 1995年，密特朗结束总统任期，将权力交给雅克·希拉克。卸任后不久，他于1996年1月8日因前列腺癌在巴黎逝世，享年79岁。密特朗晚年公开了自己与安妮·帕伊隆的婚外情关系，以及他有一个私生女的事实，这一公开打破了法国政坛的传统。密特朗的政治遗产复杂而深远，他重塑了法国左翼政治，推动了欧洲一体化，但也因其战时维希政府经历和执政后期的经济政策受到批评。他的执政风格、政治智慧和长期影响力使他成为法国现代史上最重要的政治人物之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1995, Mitterrand ended his presidency, transferring power to Jacques Chirac. Shortly after leaving office, he died of prostate cancer in Paris on January 8, 1996, at the age of 79. In his later years, Mitterrand publicly acknowledged his extramarital relationship with Anne Pingeot and his secret daughter, breaking with traditional French political norms. Mitterrand's political legacy is complex and profound; he reshaped French left-wing politics, promoted European integration, but was also criticized for his wartime Vichy government connections and economic policies during his later years. His governing style, political wisdom, and long-term influence make him one of the most significant political figures in modern French history.

appraisal.zh: 密特朗通常被视为法国现代史上最具改革色彩的总统之一：1981年的左翼转折重塑了法国政治格局，社会改革改善了工人阶级与弱势群体的处境，他对欧洲一体化的推动也使法国居于欧洲事务的核心。其政治韧性与东山再起的能力，使他成为法国任期最长的总统之一。不过也有研究者指出，他早年在维希政府的经历始终是难以抹去的污点，国有化政策受挫、后期转向实用主义背离左翼理想，用人上的任人唯亲以及执政末期的失业与财政问题，都使他的遗产呈现复杂而矛盾的面貌。
appraisal.en: Mitterrand is generally seen as one of modern France's most reform-minded presidents: the 1981 left turn reshaped the political landscape, social reforms improved conditions for workers and the disadvantaged, and his drive for European integration placed France at the center of European affairs. His resilience and repeated comebacks made him one of the longest-serving presidents. Yet researchers also point to his early Vichy record as an enduring stain, the failure of nationalization, a later pragmatism that departed from left-wing ideals, nepotism in appointments, and the unemployment and fiscal troubles of his final years—leaving a complex and contradictory legacy.

supporter.zh: 密特朗被视为法国现代史上最具改革精神的总统之一。他通过1981年的'左翼转折'改变了法国的政治格局，推行了一系列社会改革，改善了工人阶级和弱势群体的生活条件。他坚定推动欧洲一体化，使法国在欧洲事务中发挥核心作用。密特朗的政治智慧和坚韧不拔的精神，使他能够在政治生涯中多次东山再起，最终成为法国历史上任期最长的总统之一。他的执政风格优雅而富有魅力，代表了法国政治文化的精髓。
supporter.en: Mitterrand is regarded as one of France's most reform-minded presidents in modern history. His 'left turn' in 1981 transformed France's political landscape, implementing social reforms that improved living conditions for the working class and disadvantaged groups. He steadfastly promoted European integration, positioning France as a central player in European affairs. Mitterrand's political wisdom and resilience enabled him to make political comebacks multiple times, eventually becoming one of France's longest-serving presidents. His elegant and charismatic governing style embodied the essence of French political culture.

critic.zh: 批评者认为密特朗的执政存在严重缺陷。他早期的维希政府合作经历成为其政治生涯的污点，尽管他后来转向抵抗运动，但这一历史始终被质疑。经济政策上，他国有化政策失败，导致法国经济竞争力下降；后期转向实用主义又背离了左翼理想。密特朗还被批评任人唯亲，特别是任命其密友和情妇担任重要职位。他的执政后期，法国面临高失业率、财政赤字和社会分裂等问题，这些政策失误对法国经济结构产生了长期负面影响。
critic.en: Critics argue that Mitterrand's presidency had serious flaws. His early collaboration with the Vichy government remained a stain on his political career, despite his later shift to the resistance movement. Economically, his nationalization policies failed, reducing France's economic competitiveness, while his later shift to pragmatism betrayed left-wing ideals. Mitterrand was also accused of nepotism, particularly in appointing close friends and his mistress to important positions. During his later years, France faced high unemployment, budget deficits, and social divisions, with these policy mistakes having long-term negative impacts on France's economic structure.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，密特朗被视为一位复杂而矛盾的政治人物。他既是法国传统政治精英的代表，又是变革的推动者；既有坚定的民族立场，又是欧洲一体化的积极倡导者。密特朗的形象超越了简单的左右划分，体现了法国政治的连续性与变革性。他的执政风格、个人魅力和政治智慧使他成为法国政治文化的象征。在流行文化中，密特朗的形象经常与优雅、神秘和权力联系在一起，他的故事被改编成多部影视作品，反映了法国社会对这位复杂政治人物的持续关注和解读。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Mitterrand is viewed as a complex and contradictory political figure. He was both a representative of French political elite and a driver of change; holding firm national positions while actively promoting European integration. Mitterrand's image transcends simple left-right divisions, embodying the continuity and transformation of French politics. His governing style, personal charisma, and political wisdom have made him a symbol of French political culture. In popular culture, Mitterrand's image is often associated with elegance, mystery, and power, with his story adapted into numerous films and works, reflecting French society's ongoing fascination with this complex political figure.

self.zh: 政治不是一场游戏，而是一种使命。
self.en: Politics is not a game, it is a mission.
